messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock the follow-on sprint for the next 2w. Acme flagged 3 issues: one streaming drop (P1), a rendering glitch (P2), and design wants "smart rerank" enhancement. How do we prioritize?

sam: I looked — streaming drop is P1. High customer impact, reproduction is consistent. Hotfix recommended.

krishna: Criteria we should use: severity, customer SLA impact, rollback complexity, dev effort, and long-term value. If streaming is P1 -> hotfix. Enhancements can be scheduled.

jeff: Telemetry: during the drop window we see ~12% request/sec decline and 30% increase in error rate for ACME keys. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/acme/streams

product-bot: Created card PRJ-4321 "streaming drop hotfix" — https://redwood.inc/backlog/PRJ-4321

ashley: Propose split plan: 1) urgent hotfix + canary (owner @sam), 2) enhancement spike next sprint to spec the rerank (owner @maya). Also add perf ACs for the hotfix.

sam: Ack. Hotfix ETA ~48h if infra noops. I'll prepare canary and rollback steps.

krishna: Sounds good. Maya, please update acceptance criteria and add tests. Perf target: p99 <200ms for affected endpoints.

maya: On it — will add AC, regression prompts, and link to QA tests in PRJ-4321. 

jeff: I'll watch canary and add alerts. If rollback needed -> revert model routing and scale down to baseline. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. locking plan: hotfix=now, enhancement=next sprint groomed. I'll post follow-up notes.
